home.title: Yayatoh
home.tagline: I tuoi eventi e i tuoi biglietti appariranno presto qui.

discover.title: Find events

dateError.from_format: Write the first date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2027-05-01.
dateError.to_format: Write the last date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2027-05-31.
dateError.order: The last date is before the first date.

discover.nearMeDenied: Allow location while you use the app to see events near you. You can try again.
discover.nearMeBlocked: Location is turned off for Yayatoh. Turn it on in Settings to see events near you.
discover.nearMeUnavailable: Check that location services are on and try again. Your position is only used for this search.
discover.rateLimited: You're searching very fast. Wait a moment and try again.
discover.emptyBody: Try other words, another date or fewer filters.

event.notFoundBody: It may have ended, been removed or be private.
event.timezone: Times are in the event's time zone ({zone}).
event.notOnSale: Tickets for this event aren't on sale.
event.noTickets: Tickets aren't on sale here yet.
event.minPerOrder: {count, plural, one {Minimum # ticket per order} other {Minimum # tickets per order}}
event.maxPerOrder: {count, plural, one {Up to # ticket per order} other {Up to # tickets per order}}
event.maxReached: {count, plural, one {Most you can buy: # ticket} other {Most you can buy: # tickets}}

webOnly.title: Buy on the web
webOnly.body: Tickets with access to the live stream are sold on the website, not in the app.
webOnly.hybridNote: Some tickets include live-stream access. Those are bought on the web.
webOnly.passBody: This ticket includes live-stream access, which is sold on the web.

shortLink.notFoundTitle: That link doesn't match an event
shortLink.notFoundBody: The code may be mistyped, or the event is no longer public.

checkout.loadErrorBody: Go back to the event and try again.
checkout.emptyBody: Choose your tickets on the event page first.
checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.priceNote: Prices include fees. The final total is confirmed when you pay, including any promo code.

issues.title: Fix your selection
issues.unavailable: {name} isn't available any more. Go back and remove it.
issues.belowMinimum: {count, plural, one {{name} needs at least # ticket.} other {{name} needs at least # tickets.}}
issues.aboveMaximum: {count, plural, one {{name} allows up to # ticket per order.} other {{name} allows up to # tickets per order.}}
issues.webOnly: {name} is bought on the web. Go back and remove it.

signIn.title: Sign in to buy tickets
signIn.body: Your tickets are saved to your account, so you can find them in the app.

checkout.sentTo: Your tickets will be sent to {email}.

reason.checkout_questions: This event asks a few questions at checkout, and the app can't show them yet.
reason.seat_selection: This event sells numbered seats. You choose your seats on the web.
reason.registration: This event uses registration with approval or groups, which finishes on the web.
reason.transfer_fee: These tickets have a transfer fee that you accept on the web.
reason.choose_your_amount: You choose the amount for this ticket, which you do on the web.
reason.other: This order can't be finished in the app.

buyOnWeb.title: These tickets are bought on the web
buyOnWeb.body: Tickets with access to the live stream can't be bought in the app. Your other tickets are still selected.

checkout.cancelledBody: Nothing was charged. Your tickets are still selected, so you can pay again.

errors.title: We couldn't place your order
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again. Nothing was charged.
errors.rateLimited: {minutes, plural, one {You've started too many orders. Try again in # minute.} other {You've started too many orders. Try again in # minutes.}}
errors.notFound: This event isn't available any more.
errors.unauthenticated: Please sign in again to buy tickets.
errors.unverifiedEmail: Verify your email address in Account before buying tickets.
errors.riskBlocked: We can't place this order. If you think this is a mistake, contact the organizer.
errors.orgSuspended: This organizer isn't selling tickets right now.
errors.holdExpired: Your hold on these tickets ran out. Try again to hold them anew.
errors.promoInvalid: That promo code isn't valid for these tickets.
errors.soldOut: Some tickets just sold out. Go back and review your selection.
errors.invalid: We couldn't place this order. Check your selection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged. Please try again.

checkout.holdNote: We hold your tickets for 10 minutes while you pay.
checkout.securePageNote: You pay on a secure page and come back here when you're done.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.signInAgain: Please sign in again to see your orders.
orders.emptyBody: Tickets you buy show up here.
orders.notFoundBody: This order isn't in your account. Check you're signed in with the email you bought with.

confirmed.title: You're going!
confirmed.body: Your order is confirmed and your tickets are in My tickets. We also emailed them to you.

processing.title: Confirming your payment
processing.body: Your payment went through on the payment page and the provider is confirming it. This usually takes a few seconds.
processing.stillBody: The confirmation is taking longer than usual. You don't need to pay again. Your tickets will appear in My tickets and in your email.

orders.transferred: {count, plural, one {# ticket passed on to someone else} other {# tickets passed on to someone else}}

refund.title: Refunds
refund.policyAlways: Refunds can be requested until the event.
refund.requested: {count, plural, one {Requested for # ticket.} other {Requested for # tickets.}}

link.title: Your order
link.bannerTitle: Open this order on the web
link.body: This link comes from an order email. It opens the order page on the website. Orders in your account are in Account → Orders.
